questions.learningObjective: Identify sine sign in quadrant III
questions.stem: A city planner measures an angle in quadrant III for a lot survey. What is the sign of sine in quadrant III?

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.stem: A 45-45-90 city lot has one leg 5 m. What is the other leg?
questions.explanation: In a 45-45-90 triangle the legs are equal, so the other leg is 5. A tempting wrong value is 5 root 2, the hypotenuse.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.topic: Choosing a law of sines or cosines
questions.stem: A triangular lot has side 10 m opposite a 50 degree angle. Using the law of sines, what is the side opposite the 80 degree angle to two decimals?
questions.explanation: By the law of sines, x over sin 80 equals 10 over sin 50, so x is about 12.86. A tempting wrong value is 10, reusing the given side.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.stem: A circular road has radius 5 m and central angle 72 degrees. What is the arc length?
questions.explanation: 72 degrees is 2 pi over 5 radians, so arc length is 5 times 2 pi over 5 equals 2 pi. The tempting values mishandle conversion.
